name: Chiapas

standard.note: Chiapas's 2025 plate is a clean white design with CHIAPAS across the top and the government's 'Humanismo que transforma' logo at the bottom, packed with security features: a QR code, a hologram and an augmented-reality logo.

plates.title: Current design (2025)
plates.fact: Chiapas's 2025 plate is a clean white design with CHIAPAS across the top and the government's 'Humanismo que transforma' logo at the bottom, packed with security features: a QR code, a hologram and an augmented-reality logo.

notes: Re-plating began February 2025 (Secretaria de Hacienda de Chiapas). haciendachiapas.gob.mx and ingresos.haciendachiapas.gob.mx would not load from this environment (browser error page), so no official image was found; clean images exist only on news sites and Facebook. The previous design is being replaced by the 2025 canje; I could not confirm an official end-of-validity date, so it is not listed. No specialty plates found.
